|| **Parameter** | **Description** ||
|| `allow_missing_progress_marker` | **Type**: `bool`
**Default value**: `false`
With `exactly_once`, lets a sink partition start when its progress marker cannot be trusted, although messages the pipeline has not acknowledged may already be committed to Kafka. Those messages are written again and may be duplicated. The marker is lost when the consumer group offset expires (the broker's `offsets.retention.minutes` after the last commit), is deleted, or is reset. It is read when a sink partition starts; unset it once the pipeline has recovered. ||
|#
